work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CLIX gives the Vatican chapter two golden crosses from Maastricht containing relics of the True Cross; LF36265 → LF36271 across running title LF36268; complete 18 January 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF36246–36246; the source closing at LF36317–36320 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima octava ianuarii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo octavo, pontificatus Nostri anno septimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
